svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.20.6.1 Thickness of Exterior Walls
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.20.6.1 Thickness of Exterior Walls
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.20 MASONRY AND INSULATING CONCRETE FORM WALLS NOT IN CONTACT WITH THE GROUND

g.text: Wall not less than 140 mm thick, (1)
Walls not more than 2.8 m (9′-2¼″) high at the eaves,
Top storey: not less than 140 mm
Each wythe not less than 90 mm (3 9/16″), (3)

svg.text: Masonry exterior walls, other than cavity
walls, in 1-storey buildings and the top
storeys of 2- and 3-storey buildings are not
provided the walls are not more than 2.8 m
(9′-2¼″) high at the eaves and 4.6 m (15′-1⅛″)
high at the peaks of gable ends.
The exterior walls of the bottom storeys of
storeys of 3-storey buildings, are not less
In exterior walls of more than one wythe, each
wythe is not less than 90 mm (3 9/16″) thick.
Drawn: A walls only, roof not shown. B cut through, floors cut back. Storey heights in B illustration only.
